title: Alternating Critical - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Alternating Critical in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Verso's Drafts - Candy Land entrance, blue tunnel

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Alternating Critical is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: On a Critical hit, the next non-Critical hit deals 100% increased damage.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: On a Critical hit, the next non-Critical hit deals 100% increased damage.

sections.title: How to Get Alternating Critical
sections.content: Location: Verso's Drafts - Candy Land entrance, blue tunnel.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
